description: Report progress on a task you started, using its exact eight-character key. The user reads it in the task timeline. Write plain text: what you did, decisions you made and why, what is next, and any blocker. In progress reports and hand-off notes, also flag missing, outdated or conflicting information you encountered, even if you worked around it: what is unclear or wrong, which sources you checked, and optionally an evidence-supported correction. Distinguish confirmed findings from guesses. If you cannot finish, log a hand-off note before stop_task: what is done, what is left, where your work is, and what you need from the user. Keeps your claim active.
name: log_task_progress
title: Log task progress
